title: Height from energy conservation
description: Essential: Correctly applies conservation of mechanical energy to relate release height H to collision speed v, yielding H = v²/(2g).

title: Tension from centripetal force
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion at the bottom of the swing, setting net force (F - mg) equal to centripetal force mv²/L.

title: Post-collision velocity
description: Important: Correctly applies conservation of momentum to the perfectly inelastic collision, finding the combined velocity v' = v/2.

title: Energy loss calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the mechanical energy loss as the difference between initial kinetic energy of A and final kinetic energy of the combined mass, yielding ΔE = ¼mv².

title: Units and symbolic form
description: Optional: Presents final answers in correct symbolic form with appropriate units or dimensional consistency.

title: Sign error in tension
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly writes tension as F = mg - mv²/L (wrong direction of net force) or omits the weight term entirely.

title: Momentum conservation error
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the doubled mass after collision in momentum conservation, or treats the collision as elastic.

title: Energy framework confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly includes potential energy in the collision energy balance, or misidentifies the system for energy loss calculation.
